subject.title: [Feature]: Automatic Output Sanitization for Sensitive Data

question: Should OpenClaw add a core automatic sensitive-output redaction boundary and config surface for final agent-visible outputs, or should this remain plugin/hook-owned until a narrower missing core API is identified?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the right boundary affects security defaults, output correctness, plugin ownership, config compatibility, and false-positive policy, which automation should not decide alone.

options.title: Define Core Boundary First
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask security/product owners to approve the redaction boundary, defaults, exception model, and migration/config shape before any PR.

options.title: Route To Plugin Policy
options.body: Treat current hooks as sufficient and ask for a ClawHub/plugin implementation unless a concrete missing hook or SDK API is found.

options.title: Split Narrow Leak Fixes
options.body: Close or narrow this broad proposal only after separate concrete leak reports cover specific output paths with reproducible failures.

recommendation.title: Define Core Boundary First
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and ask security/product owners to approve the redaction boundary, defaults, exception model, and migration/config shape before any PR.

likelyOwner.reason: This team is the strongest owner for deciding whether final-output redaction is a core security boundary or plugin-owned policy.
